name: visimark-site
description: The website's browser code: the playground application and the docs/ pages' scripts. Private and unversioned: its bundles are committed under docs/vendor/.

scripts.build:playground: bun build ../packages/visimark/src/browser/browser-entry.ts --target browser --format iife --minify --outfile ../docs/vendor/visimark-browser.js && bun build-playground.ts && bun run build:pages
scripts.build:pages: for p in index preview tutorial ci simulate mcp-server; do bun build src/pages/$p-page.ts --target browser --format iife --minify --outfile ../docs/vendor/visimark-site-$p.js || exit 1; done
